profile.input_contract: JSON nuclide chain, decay constants, initial populations, and observation times.
profile.output_contract: JSON nuclide population metrics consumed by typed verifier.
profile.adapter: Python decay-chain runner with input/output adapters under SUT/decay_chain/.

mrs.description: The 3-nuclide Bateman decay chain A→B→C is linear in the initial quantities. Scaling every initial N by factor > 1 must scale the accumulated end-nuclide N_C_final by the same factor.

explanation_profile.meta_pattern_rationale: Mono MR: The 3-nuclide Bateman decay chain A→B→C is linear in the initial quantities.
explanation_profile.transformation_semantics: Apply ScaleInitial via transform steps [ScaleInitial@] to derive follow-up input while preserving unrelated fields.
explanation_profile.observable_summary: Observe `N_C_final` from source and follow-up outputs for MR `decay-chain-scale-initial`.
explanation_profile.predicate_summary: Predicate `greater` / `GreaterThan` checks the expected relation on `N_C_final`.
explanation_profile.tolerance_summary: Ordinal predicate: no numeric tolerance is applied beyond the declared ordering relation.
explanation_profile.applicability: Applicable when SUT `decay-chain` exposes sample `sample/three_nuclide.json`, the transform target fields, and output `N_C_final`; otherwise not applicable.
explanation_profile.failure_meaning: Failure indicates the SUT output, adapter mapping, or predicate evidence disagrees with the declared metamorphic expectation.

mrs.description: Mass conservation MP_inv: the Bateman chain A→B→C conserves total nuclide count (no production/absorption). Scaling lambda_A must not change the conserved total = N_A+N_B+N_C at t_final.

explanation_profile.meta_pattern_rationale: Inv MR: Mass conservation MP_inv: the Bateman chain A→B→C conserves total nuclide count (no production/absorption).
explanation_profile.transformation_semantics: Apply ScaleField via transform steps [ScaleField@/params/lambda_A] to derive follow-up input while preserving unrelated fields.
explanation_profile.observable_summary: Observe `total` from source and follow-up outputs for MR `bateman-mass-conservation`.
explanation_profile.predicate_summary: Predicate `approx` / `ApproxEqual` checks the expected relation on `total`.
explanation_profile.tolerance_summary: Deterministic tolerance rel=1e-06, abs=1e-09 bounds acceptable numeric deviation.
explanation_profile.applicability: Applicable when SUT `decay-chain` exposes sample `sample/three_nuclide.json`, the transform target fields, and output `total`; otherwise not applicable.
explanation_profile.failure_meaning: Failure indicates the SUT output, adapter mapping, or predicate evidence disagrees with the declared metamorphic expectation.

mrs.description: Time-step Cauchy convergence MP_conv: doubling num_steps (halving the RK4 step size) must leave N_C_final within RK4 truncation tolerance — the integrator is already at the fine-grid plateau.

explanation_profile.meta_pattern_rationale: Conv MR: Time-step Cauchy convergence MP_conv: doubling num_steps (halving the RK4 step size) must leave N_C_final within RK4 truncation tolerance — the integrator is already at the fine-grid plateau.
explanation_profile.transformation_semantics: Apply ScaleField via transform steps [ScaleField@/params/num_steps] to derive follow-up input while preserving unrelated fields.
